description: Test suite for helper functions related to XAI tool authentication, including resolving fallback API keys, checking if the XAI tool is enabled, and obtaining API keys with priority sources.

methods.name: resolveFallbackXaiApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the fallback API key for XAI web search, prioritizing plugin configuration over legacy keys.

methods.name: resolveFallbackXaiAuth
methods.description: Returns source metadata and markers for fallback authentication based on plugin config or legacy keys.

methods.name: resolveXaiToolApiKey
methods.description: Determines the API key for the XAI tool, with fallback to environment variables.

methods.name: isXaiToolEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the XAI tool is enabled based on a configuration flag.
